proposals.evidence: In breath 2026-04-20, selected gradient_descent_landscape and particle_swarm_optimization as targets to advance machinelearning/swarmintelligence garden sequences. Both had @identity added successfully, but garden diagnosis counts did NOT change for those sequences. Root cause: garden_listener --diagnosis groups by MAP sequence, not artifact registry category. These artifacts appear in gallery maps (counted as 'gallery'), not content sequence maps. Success rate for this specific task type (advancing SCATTERED content sequences via gallery artifact identity) was 0/2.
proposals.proposed_change: In the Evaluate phase, when selecting garden_identity_leverage items, add a pre-check step: for each candidate voiceless artifact, verify it appears in the TARGET SEQUENCE'S maps (not just in a gallery map for that sequence). Use: check the map_data.json files in commons/maps/<MAP_NAME>/ for maps belonging to the sequence, verify the artifact lookup_name appears in those maps' interactables layer. Only target artifacts placed in sequence-specific maps. For gallery-placed artifacts, note that @identity improves the 'gallery' sequence count, not the content sequence count.
proposals.expected_improvement: Eliminate 0-effect garden work. When targeting machinelearning sequence, only count artifacts in ML_* maps. When targeting swarmintelligence, only count artifacts in SwarmIntelligence_* maps. This changes success rate for sequence-specific garden targeting from ~50% to ~90%+.

Garden listener showed wavefunctions voiced count UNCHANGED at 64 — the +3 voice impact landed on gallery sequence (84->87) because those artifacts are not placed in any wavefunctions sequence map's interactables layer. Item was marked items_failed in the morning breath log. This is identical in shape to the 2026-04-20 ML/swarm gradient_descent failure that originally motivated this proposal. Counter is now: 2 confirmed failures (2026-04-20, 2026-05-05), 2 confirmed counter-examples (2026-04-21 floor_plan_space, 2026-04-28 forces/flowers cascade). 3+ formal threshold NOT yet reached, but pattern is clearly recurrent and the 'do nothing' downgrade suggested earlier today is REVOKED. Recommend human reviewer keep prop-001 as 'proposed' and apply on next session, OR add a one-line pre-flight check to the breather Evaluate phase: 'before voicing artifact X to advance sequence S, grep commons/maps/<map>/map_data.json for all maps in S and confirm X.lookup_name appears in interactables.' The morning breath log already captured the lesson under discoveries[3].

proposals.evidence: The item change_sequence_documentation was deferred across 3+ breaths (2026-05-13, 2026-05-19, 2026-05-28) with an identical copied-forward reason: 'stages 2-4 cannot advance until the user authors map_data.json via Map Studio.' This premise was factually wrong. sequence_pipeline_scorer.py stage 2 (documentation, lines 102-113) checks ONLY for blurb.md OR intent.md existence under commons/maps/<MapName>/ and is fully decoupled from map_data.json (stage 4, lines 149-166). On 2026-05-29 the breath wrote 16 docs (8 maps x blurb+intent) and change HEAD advanced stage 2 -> stage 3 with ZERO map_data.json on disk. The deferral note was treated as verified fact and recopied each breath without re-testing against the tool. Net cost: change sat as the lone stage-2 spine outlier ~16 days longer than necessary. Note: this item lived in items_deferred, not items_failed, so the cooling filter never barred it — the block was purely a stale, unverified reason.
proposals.proposed_change: Add a 'deferral re-validation' step to the Read/Evaluate phases. When a candidate work item matches a prior breath's items_deferred entry, do NOT copy the deferral forward on reputation. Re-test the stated premise against actual tool behavior (one cheap check: read the relevant scorer/validator code or run the tool on a minimal case) BEFORE re-deferring. Record the premise as 'verified <date>' or 'overturned <date>' in the breath log. A deferral reason older than 2 breaths with no verification stamp must be re-checked, not recopied.
proposals.expected_improvement: Stops self-perpetuating deferral myths. Would have surfaced the change-docs opportunity on 2026-05-13 instead of 2026-05-29, recovering ~16 days and 3 wasted deferral cycles. Generalizes: any deferral whose premise is a claim about tool behavior is cheaply falsifiable and should be falsified before being trusted.

evidence_updates.note: THRESHOLD MET — prop-002 now has a SECOND independent occurrence of its meta-pattern, distinct from the change-docs deferral cluster it was opened on. This morning's breath (2026-05-30T09:05) discovered that the 2026-05-29 intent.md Gap line ('Artifacts X and Y are scaffolded names — scenes not yet built') was factually wrong: all 10 change artifact scenes already existed under algorithms/change/*.tscn, registered with valid paths in commons/artifacts/registry/change.json. The sole blocker was the missing map_data.json. The morning breath's FIRST action (checking scene existence on disk) overturned the prior breath's asserted gap in TWO tool calls. The breath named the pattern itself: 'verify-the-blocker-before-believing-it'. This is the same failure mode prop-002 targets (a copied-forward, unverified blocker/gap claim costing cycles), but on a NEW item (the change stage-3 build) and a NEW artifact (an intent.md Gap line rather than a deferral_reason). Occurrence count for the meta-pattern is now: (a) change-docs map_data myth re-copied across 2026-05-13/19/28 = 3 deferral cycles, overturned 2026-05-29; (b) change stage-3 'scenes not built' Gap, overturned 2026-05-30. That is 2 independent clusters / 4 total occurrences — well past the 3+ formal threshold. RECOMMENDATION TO HUMAN REVIEWER: apply prop-002 via /ada-skill-updater. Suggest broadening its scope from 'deferral re-validation' to 'prior-breath BLOCKER re-validation' so it also covers intent.md Gap lines and any asserted 'X is missing/not built/cannot advance' claim, not just items_deferred entries. The cheap-falsifiability principle is identical: any prior-breath claim about disk/registry/tool state must be re-checked against actual state before it is trusted or copied forward. The 2026-05-30 breath log already records this lesson under discoveries[2] and discoveries[3].

proposals.evidence: Since 2026-05-30 all 22 spine sequences sit at HEAD >= 6 (vr_testing), a human-gated stage. The 2026-05-30 note ended with an explicit retarget directive ('spine HEAD-advance era is over; shift to polish / garden voicing / non-spine'), and 2026-05-31 spent its Evaluate phase rediscovering the same wall before pivoting to garden voicing. Two consecutive breaths reasoned through the identical 'pipeline is walled' analysis. Additionally, stage-7 polish is structurally 0% in this environment because the Godot multi_shots captures dir does not exist and the 4.6 console exe path in CLAUDE.md is stale.
proposals.proposed_change: In the Evaluate phase, add a 'wall detection' pre-check: if pipeline_scorer shows every spine sequence at HEAD >= 6, AUTO-SET the breath success metric to garden-voice delta (not pipeline-avg delta) and skip the pipeline-impact ranking. Add a fixed candidate ladder for this regime: (1) garden voicing of the largest 0-voice cluster from garden_listener --diagnosis, (2) Godot polish captures ONLY if a console-capable Godot exe is found AND the run is interactive (never launch a GPU batch in an unattended scheduled run), (3) non-spine sequence scaffolding. Also: detect stale capture infra (missing console exe / missing multi_shots dir) and report stage-7 as 'blocked: infra' rather than '0% owed'.
proposals.expected_improvement: Eliminates ~1 Evaluate-phase rediscovery per breath while the VR wall persists; routes straight to the highest available autonomous lever; prevents misreading stage-7 polish as owed work and prevents risky unattended Godot launches.
